title: DataTransferData
description: data of data.transfer (PRD 9.5). Data crossed the bridge of connector: artifact is the item that crossed, pinned to its version (null when nothing is stored, such as a delete), and the event's item is what the world draws. out is a side effect released by the outbox, so outbox_id names that entry; in is a read under the connection the person consented to. Either way the event carries authz (for in, the person's consent). No recipients or message bodies.
